title: SIF (Sharked Invisible Frames)
description: Just a plugin that makes frames invisible when you right-click shears
body:
# InvisibleFrames

A simple Paper/Purpur plugin that allows you to toggle the visibility of item frames by right-clicking them while sneaking with shears. Perfect for creating clean builds without visible frames cluttering your world.

---

## Features

* Make item frames invisible while keeping the items inside.
* Toggle frame visibility using **sneak + shears**.
* Preserves item rotation and contents.
* Prevents accidental frame rotation when frames are marked as processed.
* Handles item insertion/removal automatically.
* Glowing effect applied when frames are visible.

---

## How to Use

1. Hold **shears** in your hand.
2. Sneak (shift) and right-click an item frame:

   * If the frame contains an item → it becomes invisible and non-glowing.
   * If the frame is empty → it becomes visible and glowing.
3. Right-click without sneaking is prevented on processed frames to avoid accidental rotation.

---

## Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.21+
* **Server Software:** Paper, Purpur
